title: Agnieszka Piasecka - Videos
description:
Attorney Agnieszka "Aga" Piasecka has more than 20 years combined experience as a lawyer in Poland and the United States. She obtained her Juris Doctorate from Stetson University College of Law in Florida, Masters Degree in Law from Jagiellonian University in Poland and speaks English, Polish, Spanish and Italian. 

Attorney Piasecka has personally experienced the United States Immigration process and can assist you in obtaining your Green Card and U.S. Citizenship in the entire United States including Florida, New Mexico and Colorado. Her other areas of practice in Florida include: Wills and Trusts / Estate Planning, Real Estate Law, Personal Injury and Collaborative Divorce.

The information in Agnieszka Piasecka's videos is provided for educational purposes only and does not constitute or replace legal advice.

For more Information visit: https://piaseckalaw.com
